definitions: A measure of the profitability of a business in relation to the equity invested by shareholders.
The amount of net income returned as a percentage of shareholders' equity.
An indicator of how efficiently a company is using shareholders' money to generate profits.
examples: Investors often look at return on equity to assess a company's financial health.
The company boasted a high return on equity last quarter.
Improving return on equity is a key goal for many management teams.
